title: Apple iPhone Duo Review: Is It Worth It?

claims.claim: iPhone Duo, Samsung'un ilk Galaxy Fold modelinden yedi yıl sonra piyasaya çıkıyor.

evidence.quote: The iPhone Duo arrives seven years after Samsung’s first Galaxy Fold.

claims.claim: iPhone Duo modelinin iç ekranı 7.6 inç büyüklüğündedir.

evidence.quote: several apps I’ve tried to open on the sprawling 7.6-inch screen look awful.
It’s a little hard to review the iPhone Duo. I’ve been toting Apple’s first folding smartphone for the past week, and several apps I’ve tried to open on the sprawling 7.6-inch screen look awful.
Meanwhile on the inside, there's a larger 1,398 x 2,034 7.6-inch panel with a matching 1:1.4 aspect ratio and lofty luminance.

claims.claim: iPhone Duo'nun dış ekranı 5.4 inç boyutundadır.

evidence.quote: The 5.4-inch outer screen is still big enough to be useful
The 5.4-inch outer screen is still big enough to be useful, and the hinge glides open gracefully and stays put at various angles.
On the outside, the Duo features a glossy 1,878 x 2,670 5.4-inch OLED display with 120Hz ProMotion support and an impressive peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits.
as the iPhone Duo’s hefty 254 grams (heavier than an iPhone 18 Pro Max) can get tiring

I still appreciate that Samsung’s new Galaxy Z Fold8 is super lightweight at 201 grams, as the iPhone Duo’s hefty 254 grams (heavier than an iPhone 18 Pro Max) can get tiring after extended doomscrolling.

The main drawback to the Duo's beefy build is that it weighs 254 grams (8.96 ounces), which is more than 25 percent heavier than a Galaxy Z Fold 8, despite the latter having the same number of cameras and larger displays.

claims.claim: Samsung'un yeni Galaxy Z Fold8 modeli 201 gram ağırlığındadır.

evidence.quote: I still appreciate that Samsung’s new Galaxy Z Fold8 is super lightweight at 201 grams

The main drawback to the Duo's beefy build is that it weighs 254 grams (8.96 ounces), which is more than 25 percent heavier than a Galaxy Z Fold 8, despite the latter having the same number of cameras and larger displays.

claims.claim: iPhone Duo IP68 toz ve suya dayanıklılık derecesine sahiptir.

evidence.quote: The phone is IP68 dust- and water-resistant
The phone is IP68 dust- and water-resistant (though avoid taking the Duo to the beach, as sand is notoriously detrimental to phone hinges).

And somehow amongst all this, Apple found a way to give the Duo an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance, which is only available from one other family of foldables on sale in the US: the Pixel 11 Pro Fold line.

claims.claim: iPhone Duo dış mekanlarda 3.000 nits tepe parlaklığına ulaşabilmektedir.
iPhone Duo ön siparişleri ocak ayına kadar ertelenmiştir.
